armor.name: Patched Cloth
armor.description: Salvaged cloth, mended in three colours of thread.

armor.name: Tattered Leather
armor.description: Worn leather, soft from years of mud. Turns a casual cut.

armor.name: Aetherstone Vest
armor.description: A vest panelled with Aetherstone slabs. Hums softly when Aether is near.

armor.name: Ceremonial Robes
armor.description: Robes embroidered with old Tartarian sigils. Quickens the runecasting hand.

armor.name: Mud-glass Scales
armor.description: Mud-glass plates lashed over leather. Sheds the corrosive runoff.

armor.name: Sentinel Plate
armor.description: Reclaimed Architectural Sentinel plating. Heavy, but it remembers how to stand.

armor.name: Runic Mantle
armor.description: A mantle stitched with cooling runes. The shoulders never quite warm up.

armor.name: Founder's Harness
armor.description: Harness of the first builders. The Aether seems to step around it on instinct.
